Exercise 9. a) Table. Data: inflation at 14% on an annual basis last month, from11,2% (source: National Statistical Institute, the week before); the coin has lost about the 18% on the dollar from the beginning of the year (reported in the article). Decision: The central bank raises the main rate by one point, at 12,5%, third increase of the year (source: the bank, communicated); The government expands social programs, increases cash support to about two million households, blocks the price of subsidised bread until the end of the year (source: government, finance minister). Interpretation: According to some economists, the most expensive credit will slow down investment and weigh on small and medium-sized enterprises; likely growth below 2% ( ⁧يرجح⁩ : probability, not certainty); The Minister: the crisis is largely global. Context: loan of 3 billions of the IMF at the beginning of the year, with a reform programme (deficit reduction, more private space). b) Beyond 50 billions of dollars last year, growth of almost the 20% Annual. Factors: Smartphones spread, many young people, better electronic payments, the pandemic that changed habits. Differences: in the Gulf, it is mostly paid electronically; elsewhere dominates payment at delivery (trust in advance payment, many without bank account). Challenges: logistics (rural areas, unclear addresses), commissions for large platforms (up to one fifth of sales). Future: digital infrastructure, consumer protection laws and personal data.
